verdict.rationale: Hightouch's MCP server explicitly lets users describe an audience in plain language (e.g. 'Create an audience of customers that added an item to their cart...') and it builds the audience grounded in the warehouse schema/models via Customer Studio, with review before activation; the built-in agent also supports natural-language segment exploration. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the generated segment definition is surfaced for human review before running, and detail on how schema grounding prevents hallucinated fields.
